From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Client voice capture — run-of-show, logistics & release forms

Hi Aidan —

Great to hear BrightPath is open to a short customer video. To get us scheduled and make the shoot day smooth, can you confirm two things this week:

1) Final list of on-camera participants (name + title + pronouns if comfortable)
2) Two preferred shoot dates in the week of June 7–11 (we have a small window of studio time)

I attached an initial run-of-show and a draft release so your legal team can review ahead of time. The shoot will be a ~8–10 minute edited piece with 2–3 interview questions each and a few b-roll moments (office, product screens). If we need a remote-record option instead of in-person, let me know — we can bring FrameWorks Media in for a remote capture variant.

Attachments: shoot_schedule_v3.pdf, BrightPath_Release_Form_v2.pdf, client_talking_points.docx

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Onward: our producer Jorge will coordinate logistics once we lock a date.
From: Aidan Shaw <aidan.shaw@brightpathhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Client voice capture — run-of-show, logistics & release forms

Thanks Marcus — excited to do this.

Availability: June 8 (morning) or June 10 (afternoon) work for the team. Participants:
- Aidan Shaw, Head of Product (he/him)
- Dr. Priya Desai, Clinical Ops Lead (she/her)
- Maya Grant, Implementation Manager (she/they)

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Our legal team wants to see a redline-friendly version of the release with a one-week turnaround; can your legal/producer share a slightly more permissive clause around b-roll usage?
2) If possible, can we do a hybrid capture — in-person for Aidan and Dr. Desai, remote for Maya (she's traveling).

Happy to sign a release once we have the final language.

Best,
Aidan
Aidan Shaw | BrightPath Health
aidan.shaw@brightpathhealth.com | +1 617-555-2234

On legal: attached is a redline-friendly version of the release (same filename with _v2). Jorge, can you drop a note on the b-roll clause to make it permissive for marketing/SOC-2-safe highlights?
